review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base.js and loader.js, the two files the lessons are read against, are byte-identical to the last review. Smart moved for the neighbouring session's pair: a dropdown can take its options as data, and component rules now load the components their templates render. Neither changes an attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference the lessons teach, so none of the eight lessons changes.
